description: This file contains unit tests for the DeepElementAdded class, which handles GStreamer element events in a media playback context. The tests verify behavior such as callback registration, element type detection, and pipeline state updates within the Gst pipeline, specifically for elements like typefind, parse, dec, and audiosink.

classes.name: DeepElementAddedTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the DeepElementAdded class, setting up mock objects and common test data.

methods.name: shouldNotRegisterCallbackWhenPtrsAreNotEqual
methods.description: Test that no callback registration occurs when the parent objects of the GstElement and GstBin are not equal.

methods.name: shouldNotRegisterCallbackWhenElementIsNull
methods.description: Test that no callback registration occurs when the GstElement's name cannot be retrieved.

methods.name: shouldNotRegisterCallbackWhenElementNameIsNotTypefind
methods.description: Test that no callback is registered if the element's name does not contain 'typefind'.

methods.name: shouldRegisterCallbackForTypefindElement
methods.description: Test that a callback is registered when the element's name contains 'typefind'.

methods.name: shouldUpdatePlaybackGroupWhenCallbackIsCalled
methods.description: Test that the playback group is updated correctly when the 'have-type' callback is invoked.

methods.name: shouldAddSignalIdOfRegisteredCallbackToPlayerContext
methods.description: Test that the signal ID of the registered callback is stored in the player context.

methods.name: shouldAssignPipelineOnlyWhenElementNameIsNull
methods.description: Test that the pipeline is assigned in the context when the element's name is null.

methods.name: shouldDetectParseElement
methods.description: Test detection of a 'parse' element and update of the decode bin in the playback group.

methods.name: shouldDetectDecElement
methods.description: Test detection of a 'dec' element and update of the decode bin in the playback group.

methods.name: shouldDoNothingForNotHandledElementName
methods.description: Test that no changes occur for an element with an unrecognized name.

methods.name: shouldDoNothingWhenAudiosinkParentNameIsNull
methods.description: Test that no action is taken when the 'audiosink' element's parent name is null.

methods.name: shouldDoNothingWhenAudiosinkParentIsNotBin
methods.description: Test that no action is taken when the 'audiosink' element's parent is not a bin.

methods.name: shouldFindAudioSinkBin
methods.description: Test that the parent bin of an 'audiosink' element is correctly identified as an 'audiosinkbin'.
